jobs.occupation: Tax specialist - Brussels - International Retail Company
jobs.description:
Our client is an international player and global leader in the retail sector with a strong branding and unique company culture. They are currently expanding and reorganizing their finance team to adapt their strategy to the current market.

Jobomschrijving

As a Tax Specialist your function will be twofold. On one side reporting to the accounting manager for the Belgian HQ as well as to the CFO of the e-commerce marketplace.

Belgian HQ:

• Manage monthly VAT filings (BE, FR & LUX)
• Intrastat and statistical declarations (BE, FR & LUX)
• Managing intercompany netting processes and related tax implications.
• Ensuring compliance with indirect tax, customs, and cross-border transaction requirement
• Ensure accurate corporate tax provisions (ISOC)
• Oversee quarterly VAT calculations
• Management Report (PM)
• Corporate tax calculation, transfer pricing and client listings
• Support Pillar 2 compliance 

E-commerce Marketplace:

• Support tax projects and implement tax controls.
• Ensure compliance with DAC7, Deemed Supplier, and C2C requirements.
• Review and validate invoice flows.
• Support profit split analyses and related tax matters.
• Act as the main tax contact for the marketplace business.
• Coordinate with local tax specialists on international projects.
• Identify tax risks and support process improvements.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Master's degree in Finance or Law, specialized in Tax / Fiscal sciences
• Fluent in English and good command of French or Dutch
• Strong expertise in corporate tax and indirect tax (VAT)
• Hands-on with proven ability to execute operational tax tasks
• Critical mindset, ability to analyse future impact of regulations on the business
• Experience in international and cross-border tax environments
• Ability to manage multiple compliance cycles (monthly, quarterly, annual)
• Strong communication skills for stakeholder and cross-country coordination

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

-

For our client in Meer, we are looking for a maintenance technician.

• As a maintenance technician, you are responsible for repairing technical malfunctions in the production machines.
• The issues can be both electrical and mechanical, but the majority are industrial electrical faults. You are responsible for identifying the malfunction and resolving it.
• In addition, you carry out equipment overhauls.
• You ensure that operators and production staff can continue working at all times.
• Preventive and major maintenance tasks are carried out on Saturdays.
• Furthermore, you make suggestions to optimize the process and proactively prevent malfunctions.

• You hold an A2 diploma in electromechanics or industrial electricity, or equivalent through experience
• You are very proficient in reading electrical diagrams
• You are willing to work in a pig slaughterhouse (you are not required to do any slaughtering yourself, only to maintain the machines)
• You have a good command of Dutch or English
• You are willing to work in a shift system. In addition, you will work on Saturdays and can take a compensatory day off during the week (not on Monday or Friday)
• Knowledge of PLCs and/or I/O configuration (not programming) is a plus
• You are flexible with working hours and can work both independently and in a team
• You are willing to work in varying temperature conditions

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Charleroi - Industry sector
Project Finance in Charleroi - Industry sector

jobs.description:
Our client is an energy company.

Jobomschrijving

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including development, engineering, finance, tax, legal and operations, and senior management, while collaborating with external advisors, lenders, investors and counterparties to deliver strategic projects and transactions.

• Buy-side M&A transaction: Together with the Director, leading financial appraisal, due diligence, and structuring of BESS and PV transactions.
• Modelling: Build and stress-test investment models (revenue, degradation, volatility, constraints) and translate outputs into clear investment recommendations and strategic decision making to the Director.
• Negotiation: Together with Senior Legal evaluate, negotiate, and optimize key project contracts (PPA, tolling, EPC, O&M/LTSA) through a risk-return lens to protect capital and increase value.
• Project Financing: Ensure projects meet international project finance bankability requirements and optimize cost of capital through robust structuring - in charge of document negotiation with equity and debt providers.
• Strategy: Contribute to portfolio strategy by assessing future risks and opportunities (e.g., grid connection models, longer duration assets, alternative technologies, new jurisdictions).
• Monitoring: Monitor execution and early operational performance, validating investment assumptions and driving feedback loops into future decisions (ie. monitoring actual portfolio performance against budgets and forecasts, preparing performance reports including key financial and business metrics).
• Invoices & Budget: Oversees (and be responsible for) cost control, invoice tracking, annual budgeting and financial reporting.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field.
• 7-10 years of experience in investment banking, other forms of M&A advisory, project finance, valuation, ideally with exposure and/or strong interest for renewable energy and energy transition
• Strong financial modelling skills and an understanding of project and corporate finance
• Excellent analytical and presentation skills
• Ability to manage work under pressure in a collaborative environment
• Commercial, outward looking, and focusing on adding value
• Strong critical thinking and willingness to challenge assumptions constructively across the team (technical, development, commercial)
• Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships across internal and external stakeholders
• Fluency in English. French or Dutch is a plus.

• Ability to work independently and take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency in analyzing sales data and market trends.
• Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - International clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
